tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Tool Pantry catalog of 216 free browser tools for PDF, images, video, audio and text. Use this first: it returns the exact tool page URL for a user request (e.g. "compress image to 100kb", "merge pdf", "heic to jpg").

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Count characters, words, sentences, paragraphs, lines and reading time for a piece of text.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: Hash a string with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512. Returns hex and base64 digests.

tools.name: generate_password
tools.description: Generate random passwords using the platform crypto RNG.

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: Validate, pretty-print or minify a JSON string.

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Base64 encode or decode UTF-8 text.

tools.name: color_convert
tools.description: Convert a hex colour to RGB and HSL.

tools.name: qr_code
tools.description: Generate a QR code for any text or URL. Returns SVG markup (or JSON with the SVG string).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_password" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Generate random passwords using the platform crypto RNG.
